architectureMarkdown:
# notes-mcp-server

A small Node.js MCP server exposing `search_notes` and `add_note` over Streamable HTTP.

## Components

- `src/server.ts`: Express app and transport
- `src/tools.ts`: tool definitions

boundaries.label: Agent to Notes MCP Server
boundaries.description: Tool calls from the LLM agent to the server. Arguments may be influenced by untrusted content.
boundaries.evidence: src/server.ts registers POST /mcp and accepts tool calls from any authenticated client.

boundaries.label: Tool output to Agent context
boundaries.description: Note contents are returned into the model context.
boundaries.evidence: src/tools.ts search_notes returns raw note text.

vectors.title: Prompt injection via stored note text
vectors.description: A note containing instructions is returned verbatim and may be followed by the agent.
vectors.evidence: search_notes returns note.body without delimiting or sanitising it.

findings.vectorTitle: Prompt injection via stored note text
findings.title: Note text is returned to the model without delimiting
findings.description: Untrusted note bodies are placed directly into tool results.
findings.recommendation: Wrap tool output in a structural delimiter and strip instruction-like markup before it reaches the model.
findings.evidence: src/tools.ts line 41: return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: note.body }] }
